subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the remaining work for issue 43374 be driven by a canonical current-main live repro, split into narrower runtime/provider/Telegram issues, or closed only after proving the merged mitigations eliminate the original four-agent timeout pattern?
rationale: The report crosses Telegram runner concurrency, provider transport, model fallback, session locks, and launch defaults, and current main shows partial mitigations but not enough evidence to choose a safe implementation boundary automatically.

options.title: Require canonical live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open and request a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing a code or config change.

options.title: Split narrower bottleneck issues
options.body: Move the remaining work into specific runtime, provider transport, or Telegram concurrency issues if maintainers decide this report is too broad to own directly.

options.title: Close after mitigation proof
options.body: Close only if a current-main live run shows the reported all-provider timeout pattern no longer occurs with comparable multi-agent Telegram load.

recommendation.title: Require canonical live repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and request a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing a code or config change.
